meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India
meta.coverage: Appropriation of profit of every scheduled commercial bank, each year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1115 (data provider DP1), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Old private sector banks, Csb bank limited, Appropriations, Transfer to Capital Reserves on 2009-03-01; Old private sector banks, Dhanlaxmi bank limited, Profit, Profit Brought Forward on 2011-03-01; Old private sector banks, Lakshmi vilas bank ltd, Profit, Profit Brought Forward on 2007-03-01).
